entries.heading: OFFICE OF INTERNATIONAL FORESTRY
ancestors: Subtitle C—Reauthorization of Other Forestry-Related Laws
entries.text:
SEC. 8202. OFFICE OF INTERNATIONAL FORESTRY.

    Section 2405(d) of the Global Climate Change Prevention Act of 1990 
(7 U.S.C. 6704(d)) is amended by striking ``2012'' and inserting 
``2018''.
